scope: Completed cycles only; raw request payload objects and generated messages including reasoning/content plus finish reasons. Response IDs/creation times/usage/cache counts intentionally not part of generated-output equality. No token IDs/logprobs requested; text equality does not establish score equality.
interpretation_limits: First external warmup has different uncached prompt work; do not rank backends using warmups.
Repeated identical prompts/outputs can make caches very hot; findings apply only to this workload.
No backend winner inferred by this audit.
